Consider the observed data and the results of any preliminary analyses conducted on this data.
3. If the results of the study are consistent with predictions made in the research hypothesis then proceed to Step 12.
4. If the results contradict the predictions made by in the research hypothesis continue on to Step 5.
5. Use statistical software to perform statistical tests on the data.
6. Manipulate the data and/or its coding structure in such a way that results now match predictions in the experiment hypothesis.
7. Return to step 5 and repeat this process until the results obtained in the output meet the desired requirements.
8. Once you have sufficiently manipulated the data and its coding structure to obtain the desired results perform a sensitivity analysis.
9. (Optional) If you accidentally uncover discrepancies between results and the predictions made in the research hypothesis manipulate the data processing and coding again until you return to the desired results.
10
